versions.changelog:
overwing 1.8.0

- Added support for passwordless account signup directly from the CLI, requiring no email or password.
- Increased daily check limit for passwordless accounts to 50.
- Introduced domain verification workflow for account recovery and increased usage limits.
- Updated documentation for new signup and domain management flows.
- Removed outdated skill-card documentation.

- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- Updated SKILL.md for content and clarity.
- No functional changes to API or usage.
- Maintenance release.
Overwing Beacon: beacon sample, start, report

evaluate works with no key: 10 checks a day, inputs up to 2,000 characters, text not stored. New Languages section: text can be in any language, tested in nine besides English. terms now reads the discovery file listing every paid endpoint and price.

Atlas lookups now work with no key (10 a day). New Overwing Tower commands: set up a workflow, mint scoped agent keys, submit typed actions to a legacy system, wait for human review, undo, and verify signed receipts.
Atlas: identify any User-Agent string (who), search the agent registry (agents), public summary (atlas)
Initial release: evaluate, batch, usage, signup, x402 terms; verdict guidance for agents.
